title: Churn prediction for a subscription box company
text: Built a churn classifier for a subscription e-commerce client with 120k customers. Compared logistic regression, random forest and gradient boosting with stratified 5-fold cross-validation. Handled class imbalance with class weights and threshold tuning; reported precision, recall and PR-AUC instead of accuracy. The gradient boosting model reached 0.71 PR-AUC versus 0.52 for the previous rules. Delivered a reproducible pipeline and a model card documenting limitations.

title: RAG assistant over support tickets
text: Designed a retrieval-augmented support assistant over 40k historical tickets for a SaaS company. Used hybrid BM25 and dense retrieval in Qdrant with a cross-encoder reranker, served through FastAPI. Built an evaluation set of 300 questions and measured answer faithfulness; deflected 23% of tier-1 tickets in the first month.

title: Celery task queue for nightly ETL
text: Replaced cron scripts with a Celery and Redis task queue for a logistics client's nightly ETL into PostgreSQL. Added retries with exponential backoff, idempotent tasks and Flower monitoring. Nightly job failures dropped from about twice a week to none over three months. Everything ran in Docker Compose.

title: Demand forecasting for a grocery chain
text: Forecast weekly demand for 900 SKUs across 14 grocery stores. Benchmarked Prophet against LightGBM with lag features; LightGBM cut weighted MAPE from 31% to 22%. Delivered forecasts as a scheduled job writing to the client's warehouse.

title: docparse: PDF invoice field extraction
text: Open-source library that extracts invoice fields (vendor, totals, line items) from scanned PDFs. Uses Tesseract OCR and a fine-tuned LayoutLM model. Includes a CLI and a benchmark on 500 labelled invoices with 94% field-level accuracy.

title: docparse/train.py
text: Training script: fine-tunes microsoft/layoutlmv3-base with the Hugging Face Trainer, mixed precision, early stopping on validation F1, and exports to ONNX for CPU inference.

title: Defect detection on a production line
text: Trained a YOLO object detector to find surface defects on metal parts from line-scan camera images. Organised labelling of 6k images, reached 0.88 mAP@0.5, and deployed on an edge GPU.

title: dbt models for marketing analytics
text: Built 40 dbt models in BigQuery for a marketing agency, with tests and documentation, replacing hand-written dashboard queries. Cut dashboard refresh time from 20 minutes to 3.

title: Client review: churn project
text: 5 stars. Explained the precision/recall trade-off to our non-technical team clearly and delivered ahead of schedule.

title: Client review: RAG assistant
text: 5 stars. Set up a proper evaluation instead of eyeballing answers. Would hire again.

title: Proposal: chatbot over product docs
text: Your docs bot answers wrong because retrieval misses exact product names. I fixed the same issue for a SaaS support team with hybrid search and a reranker, and measured it on 300 real questions.

title: Proposal: ML engineer needed

title: Proposal: sales forecasting
text: Forecasting 900 SKUs taught me that Prophet is a good baseline but gradient boosting with lag features usually wins on retail data. I would start by benchmarking both on your last two years.
